an_start_2: Author's Note: Yup. This is a crossover between Fate/Grand Order and Kingdom Hearts. After playing Fate/Grand Order I became hooked on the franchise. I was already quite aware of the Fate series for a couple of years now, watched several anime based on it and read some manga, but never really played the game, so I know almost the whole lore of it. The crazy thing about this is that I've had this idea in my head for a while now and was torn between doing a Fate/Grand Order crossover with either Kingdom Hearts or The Legend of Zelda. In fact I was writing a Grand Order and Zelda crossover but stopped when I thought about Kingdom Hearts.
an_start_3: The chemistry between Kingdom Hearts and the Fate series just felt perfect for one another. Parallel worlds, time travel, magic wars. I just had to do this story adding to the fact that there hasn't been any decent Fate/Kingdom Hearts crossover out there yet. I was also torn between choosing Sora and Roxas as one of the main characters for this story until I remembered something. In some of the anime promos for Fate/Grand Order it always showed both male and female versions of Ritsuka Fujimaru to show us that we can play as either characters obviously, while in some of the manga and anime one of the genders is the main character in the media.
an_start_4: So I figured that in a bizarre sense, I can do one where it's Roxas with Gudako and in the other it will be Sora with Gudao.
an_start_5: Plus with Kingdom Hearts IV announced and coming out in two years (Not official, just assuming) this is just my way to celebrate it.
an_start_6: Anyway, this is just an experiment I'm doing just to see some reactions to it and see if I'll continue it.
